title: Create one photorealistic native-resolut
prompt: Create one photorealistic native-resolution vertical 3:4 candid flash portrait of a new fictional, clearly adult 21-year-old East Asian woman with a short black bob, wispy bangs, and a spontaneous open tooth-showing smile. She bends forward toward a slightly elevated, close camera in a narrow dim interior, looking directly into the lens. Keep the lively, imperfect party-snapshot feeling, with a muted green-cyan shadow cast, direct camera flash, softly visible fine grain, and a person-dominated composition. This is an adult fashion portrait with natural anatomy and non-explicit styling.  COMPOSITION AND SPATIAL RELATIONSHIPS Use a vertical 3:4 frame, composed at generation time without stretching anatomy or enlarging a finished image. The head sits in the upper-left portion; the bent torso travels diagonally toward the right hip, and the lowered forearms bring the eye back toward the lower center. Keep the whole bob silhouette, smiling face, both shoulders, lowered hands, visible waist strip, ruffled skirt, and bent knees within the portrait. A pale textured wall runs close behind the head and along the left edge; a dark door or vertical recess occupies the upper right. The crop may end around the lower shins, leaving the white laces and part of the boots visible without inventing an expansive room. Maintain the close perspective and foreshortening of leaning toward the camera. The person should occupy nearly all useful space, with enough edge clearance for hair and hands.  A DISTINCT ADULT FACE AND HAIR Create an individual adult face with softly oval cheeks, a gently tapered but not needle-like chin, dark expressive almond-shaped eyes, natural slightly curved brows, a compact softly defined nose, and warm coral-red lips parted in a broad asymmetrical smile with believable teeth. Her cheeks lift naturally with the smile and the eyes engage the camera. Preserve adult facial structure and subtle skin texture, with light makeup rather than doll-like smoothing. The dark black bob falls between jaw and upper neck, with rounded volume at the crown and sides, broken wispy forehead bangs, and curved ends. One side swings outward; a few fine locks break the outline at the cheek. Keep this animated short-hair silhouette, avoiding long waves or a neatly symmetrical salon finish. A long silver-toned chandelier earring with small sparkling links hangs visibly beside one cheek; the other ear may remain obscured by hair.  POSE AND ANATOMICAL SUPPORT Her torso hinges forward at the hips with knees softly bent, while her head lifts to meet the elevated lens. Shoulders slope naturally with the lean instead of posing rigidly. Both arms extend down in front of her thighs; elbows are relaxed, wrists turn inward, and the hands rest loosely close together between the bent knees. Keep two separate anatomically plausible hands, five natural fingers where visible, and coherent elbow-to-wrist continuity. The hands need not spread to display every finger. Give her a petite, light adult frame with moderately narrow relaxed shoulders, natural head-to-shoulder proportions, a slender waist, and naturally full, balanced adult contours. Do not exaggerate head size, compress the shoulder joints, enlarge the chest cage, broaden the upper back, or produce childlike proportions. Her actual full height is not established by this close bent pose. Preserve believable foreshortening and weight through the bent legs.  WARDROBE AND MATERIAL CAUSALITY She wears a loose, pale blush-white short-sleeved cotton T-shirt with a modest round crew neck. Its dropped shoulder seams and roomy sleeves create soft diagonal folds as the body leans forward. The front drapes down over the chest, while the side hem rides slightly above the waist and reveals a narrow natural strip of midriff toward the right hip. Keep the shirt opaque and casual, without opening the neckline or converting it to a fitted dress. A tiny faint, unreadable decorative mark near the lower front may remain abstract rather than becoming a slogan. Below is a white short skirt composed of soft gathered fabric with several delicate ruffled and lace-edged tiers. Preserve the layered scalloped, lightly fluttering edge and the skirt's opaque underlying coverage. The pose shows adult thighs and bent knees; no underwear, nipples, genitals, or explicit detail is exposed. Partial white lace-up boots enter the bottom of the composition. Clothing folds should respond to gravity, the forward hinge, and arm placement, retaining the everyday fit and material contrast of cotton against airy ruffles.  LIGHT, COLOR, AND PHOTOGRAPHIC SURFACE A small direct flash near the camera illuminates the face, teeth, earrings, shirt, and near leg, creating a readable shadow on the close wall and allowing the right background to fall almost black. The light is frontal and relatively hard, with real depth at the neck and under the chin; avoid replacing it with soft golden studio light. Retain a restrained green-cyan cast in the shadows, pale neutral-to-blush clothing, warm living skin, dark near-black hair, and a small coral accent at the mouth. Use subtle analog-style grain, slight snapshot softness, and gentle highlight roll-off. Keep clear eyes, convincing tooth shapes, intact fabric texture, and delicate pores without brittle sharpening or plastic skin. Do not add fake camera labels, frames, dates, logos, captions, watermarks, or unnecessary background text. No real place is being claimed.  FINAL VISUAL INTENT The smile and direct eye contact are the emotional anchor. The forward lean, diagonally flowing shirt, close wall, dangling earring, and swinging bob should feel like one briefly caught adult gesture rather than a catalog stance. Preserve natural covered curves through drape and posture, without inventing a visible full-body height or forcing a frontal curve demonstration. Balance the petite adult frame with healthy natural anatomy. Deliver a single finished photographic image at a native vertical 3:4 ratio, with no collage, extra person, anatomical duplication, artificial beauty-filter face, or change to a different clothing category.
